# F05 HEIF Decoder Third-Party Notice

This notice is traceability evidence, not a legal clearance. Before Production/global launch, counsel/product review must confirm the distribution method, source/relinking obligations and any HEVC/H.265 patent-pool or territorial licensing obligations applicable to the final launch scope.

No server-side HEIC/HEIF conversion is authorized by this bundle. The decoder is intended for the approved client-local HEIC/HEIF path only.

Upstream license texts and source references must be included with the final distribution package according to the reviewed legal release procedure. **Legal review remains an explicit launch gate.**
